title: Especialista de Infraestrutura
description:
Overview

A Minerva Foods é líder em exportação de carne bovina na América do Sul e atua também no segmento de industrializados, comercializando seus produtos para mais de 100 países. Além do Brasil, a Minerva Foods está presente no Paraguai, na Argentina, no Uruguai, na Colômbia, e possui plantas especializadas em ovinos na Austrália.

Com nossas 46 unidades industriais, oferecemos produtos saudáveis e nutritivos, que são comercializados para clientes do mundo todo por meio de nossos 23 centros de distribuição e 17 escritórios internacionais.

Cultura Organizacional

Na Minerva Foods, a cultura é construída com base em valores como orientação para resultados, comprometimento, inovação, sustentabilidade e reconhecimento . A empresa promove um ambiente inclusivo, seguro e saudável, com programas como o Estar Bem, que oferece apoio psicológico, telemedicina, nutrição e atividades físicas para colaboradores e suas famílias.

Como Especialista de Infraestrutura na Minerva Foods, você será responsável pela operação e manutenção de ambientes críticos de tecnologia, garantindo a estabilidade, disponibilidade e performance dos serviços corporativos. Atuará diretamente na sustentação de servidores, redes, serviços em nuvem e suporte de nível avançado, colaborando com equipes internas e fornecedores para assegurar a continuidade dos negócios. Além disso, será parte ativa na identificação de oportunidades de melhoria contínua, contribuindo para a evolução dos processos, aumento da eficiência operacional e redução de riscos técnicos.

Main responsibilities

O Especialista de Infraestrutura será um pilar técnico na equipe, responsável por garantir que nossos sistemas e redes operem com máxima eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade.

Principais atividades:

  • Gerenciamento de Infraestrutura: Administrar, sustentar e otimizar a infraestrutura de servidores (físicos e virtuais), storages e soluções de backup;
  • Administração de Redes: Gerenciar e proteger o ambiente de rede corporativa (LAN, WAN, WLAN, VPNs), incluindo a configuração e manutenção de firewalls e outros dispositivos de segurança;
  • Serviços de Diretório e Nuvem: Administrar o Active Directory, incluindo GPOs, DNS, DHCP, e gerenciar os serviços em nuvem, com foco no ecossistema Microsoft 365 (Azure AD, SharePoint, Teams);
  • Segurança da Informação: Implementar e gerenciar soluções de segurança, realizar análises de vulnerabilidade e garantir a correta aplicação das políticas de autenticação (ex: RADIUS/NPS);
  • Liderança de Projetos: Planejar, executar e documentar projetos de infraestrutura, como migrações de sistemas operacionais (ex: Windows 11), atualizações de hardware e implementação de novas tecnologias;
  • Melhoria Contínua: Analisar o ambiente atual, propor melhorias contínuas nos processos e tecnologias para aumentar a eficiência operacional, reduzir custos e mitigar riscos;
  • Suporte Especializado: Atuar como ponto de escalonamento para incidentes e problemas complexos, oferecendo soluções robustas e definitivas.

Experiências que buscamos:

  • Sólida experiência atuando como Analista de Infraestrutura Sênior ou Especialista;
  • Vivência comprovada em ambientes de virtualização;
  • Experiência prática com gerenciamento de redes corporativas e firewalls de borda;
  • Profundo conhecimento em administração de ambientes Microsoft, incluindo Windows Server e Active Directory;
  • Experiência com administração de plataformas em nuvem, preferencialmente AWS, Microsoft Azure e Microsoft 365;
  • Familiaridade com práticas de melhoria contínua.

Requirements and skills

Formação: Superior completo em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia, Sistemas de Informação ou áreas correlatas.

Conhecimentos Técnicos Essenciais:

  • Sistemas Operacionais: Windows Server (avançado), Linux (diferencial);
  • Virtualização: VMware vSphere e/ou Microsoft Hyper-V;
  • Cloud Computing: AWS, Microsoft Azure (IaaS, PaaS) e Microsoft 365;
  • Redes: TCP/IP, roteamento, switching, WiFi, VPNs, Firewalls;
  • Autenticação: RADIUS, NPS, LDAP, SAML;
  • Automação: Conhecimentos em scripting, especialmente PowerShell, para automação de tarefas no Active Directory e Azure.

Cursos e Certificações (Diferencial):

  • Certificações Microsoft (ex: Azure Administrator Associate, MCSA/MCSE);
  • Certificações de Redes (ex: Fortinet NSE 4, Cisco CCNA);
  • Certificação ITIL Foundation.

Additional information

Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto (home office), com necessidade de deslocamento para nossa sede em Barretos/SP em média 4 vezes ao ano para alinhamentos e eventos de equipe.

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer, Growth - Contract
description:
At Roofr, we’re obsessed with our customers. We constantly gather feedback to shape, prioritize, and launch the products they truly need. That’s what makes Roofr’s CRM special. We started by building essential sales tools like aerial roof measurements and digital sales proposals. But when our customers asked for a simple, affordable way to manage and scale their entire businesses, we listened. So, we created a CRM that connects these solutions—along with payments, material ordering, and more—into a seamless, powerful platform. With a clear roadmap ahead, we’re excited to continue expanding and leading the market with innovative products.

We have an amazing culture, strong financials, and best-in-class company metrics. It’s an exciting time to be part of an extraordinary startup that is already successful, yet still early enough to offer its team significant growth, equity, and the opportunity to make a real impact.

What You'll Get to Do:

  • Drive cross-product impact: Work across multiple product domains simultaneously—building experiments in Proposals, optimizing onboarding flows, and developing features that directly impact acquisition, monetization, and retention metrics
  • Move fast, responsibly: Operate in a Kanban environment where priorities shift based on experiment results and business needs, requiring you to balance rapid iteration with quality engineering practices
  • Own end-to-end user journeys: Build features that span the entire customer lifecycle—from signup and onboarding to subscription upgrades and hand-offs to implementation teams
  • Pioneer AI-driven experiences: Develop and iterate on novel AI-enhanced workflows and experiments that represent the cutting edge of roofing industry technology
  • Lead with autonomy: Work in a self-directed environment with our product designer and Growth EM, taking ownership of product decisions and driving features from conception to delivery
  • Build with experimentation in mind: Rapidly set up A/B tests and feature variations, prototype new experiences to drive user value, and help us learn and iterate on growth strategies with measurable business impact
  • Develop full-stack solutions: Build performant React components and work with Laravel backend following DDD patterns to create robust, scalable features that maintain code quality while enabling rapid experimentation
  • Make pragmatic trade-offs: Know when to optimize for speed vs. complexity, always considering the unique needs of cross-domain features and growth experimentation
  • Shape the future of roofing software: Join a small, passionate team where your individual contributions directly influence product direction and company growth trajectory

What You'll Bring to the Role:

  • Strong full-stack foundation: 5+ years of experience with JavaScript, React, and backend development (preferably OOP with Laravel/PHP), with 2+ years building scalable, multi-tenant SaaS products that serve real users
  • Database expertise : Strong PostgreSQL skills including query optimization, indexing strategies, and performance tuning for multi-tenant SaaS applications
  • Growth engineering mindset: Experience building for experimentation and metrics-driven iteration, with a track record of breaking down complex problems into testable proofs-of-concept and rapid experiments

Description

About XTEND:

XTEND builds AI‑driven, human‑guided and robotic systems that keep soldiers and first‑responders out of harm’s way. Our patented XOS operating system lets a single operator control multiple autonomous drones in GPS‑denied, high‑risk environments.

Trusted by leading defense forces, we have multi‑year contracts and a fresh $70 M Series B to scale globally. Xtend operates across X sites with roughly X employees, united by a mission‑first culture, rapid field testing, and deep AI talent.

About the position:

The VP of Marketing, based in Israel and reporting directly to the CEO, will work closely with a board‑level marketing advisor to transform XTEND’s product edge and funding momentum into a scalable global growth engine. The remit spans brand, demand, product marketing, investor relations, and marketing ops of building the team, playbooks, and dashboards that take us to Series C.

Key pillars & objectives:

  • Brand marketing — lock positioning; achieve double‑digit MoM growth in positive brand mentions and category searches. Responsible for brand content strategy and workplan.
  • Demand & pipeline — deliver qualified leads per region (US, EU, APAC) while keeping CAC within guardrails.
  • Product marketing — raise lead‑to‑demo, demo‑to‑pilot, and pilot‑to‑win conversion rates; shorten sales cycle. Responsible for strategizing and creating high‑end content to promote products.
  • Investor & ecosystem relations — nurture CEO network and prep Series C data room.
  • Strategy & ops — stand up a scalable org, roadmap, and OKR dashboard; keep spend on budget.

Responsibilities:

  • Publish brand‑to‑pipeline plan (PR, analyst, social, ambassador, “game‑over” content).
  • Launch four growth engines (SEO/GEO + content, paid ABM, partner co‑sell, events) to generate qualified pipeline.
  • Deploy a full sales‑enablement kit and persona nurtures; lift deal velocity
  • Own the marketing budget; reallocate quarterly to keep CAC payback low and a reasonable LTV:CAC ratio
  • Manage and lead a team of 5–10 external contractors in the first year; define roles & responsibilities, workflows, and performance dashboards. The main focus is on creating visual and textual cutting edge marketing content
  • Produce monthly “war‑room” dashboards by region, product, and partner; present insights weekly.
  • Lead investor‑relations marketing: quarterly progress demos, investor brief, and bi‑annual VIP demos.
  • Ensure the full martech stack is live and integrated
  • Work with creative agencies and studios to deliver cutting edge marketing content

Requirements

  • 10+ years in marketing; 8+ years at VP/Head level owning both brand and demand.
  • Proven ≥ 3× ARR growth (from 7‑ to 8‑figures) in defense‑tech, robotics, or deep‑tech B2G/B2B.
  • Managed 6‑ to 7‑figure annual marketing budgets
  • Built from scratch and led a 5+ FTEs across US/EU/APAC
  • Led at least one end‑to‑end category‑design initiative and captured market leadership
  • Double‑digit MoM brand‑awareness gains with tier‑1 media/analyst coverage
  • Executed ABM/BDR programs generating Qualified Leads.
  • Improved demo‑to‑win rate and reduced sales cycle length through PMM initiatives.
  • Established relationships with defense agencies, primes, and critical‑infrastructure buyers.
  • Startup tempo: able to ship roadmap, budget, and OKR dashboards within 45 days.
  • Data‑first operator: advanced marketing automation, analytics, and BI skills
  • Proven creative work on branding, messaging, and high‑end content creation
  • Exceptional written and spoken English; additional language (Hebrew, German, Arabic) a plus.

Why Xtend

  • Battle‑proven tech that saves lives.
  • Significant funding with a clear path to Series C.
  • Autonomy to build marketing from zero to world‑class.
  • Work alongside leading AI, robotics, and defense talent.

description:
Região de Engenheiro Coelho / Campinas, SP (com disponibilidade para viagens)

Contratante: indústria brasileira em plena expansão, dedicada a fabricar e distribuir produtos de higiene e limpeza, com forte compromisso com a qualidade e o meio ambiente.

Atendimento exclusivo B2B, focado na personalização e na melhor relação custo-benefício. Estamos em um momento decisivo de crescimento, profissionalizando nossa gestão, expandindo nossa rede de distribuidores para todo o Brasil e com a visão clara de nos tornarmos um dos três maiores players do setor.

O Supervisor Comercial será uma peça-chave na transformação e estruturação da nossa área de vendas. Buscamos um profissional com perfil "mão na massa", que não apenas gerencie, mas também construa processos, desenvolva a equipe e execute a estratégia comercial em campo. Este líder colaborará diretamente com a Diretoria Comercial para refinar e implementar o planejamento estratégico, sendo o elo fundamental entre a gestão e a força de vendas. O candidato ideal é um construtor, motivado pelo desafio de criar uma máquina de vendas robusta em um ambiente familiar, ágil e com grande potencial de crescimento.

Principais Responsabilidades:

  1. Gestão e Desenvolvimento da Equipe de Vendas: Liderar, treinar e motivar a equipe de representantes comerciais, incluindo profissionais experientes, estabelecendo uma cultura de alta performance, disciplina e foco em resultados. Recrutar, contratar e treinar novos representantes para expansão de territórios. Implementar e garantir a execução de rotinas de vendas diárias e semanais (planejamento de rotas, prospecção, positivação, follow-up). Realizar rotas em campo com a equipe para suporte, treinamento, avaliação da execução no ponto de venda e atendimento a clientes estratégicos.
  2. Estratégia e Planejamento Comercial: Colaborar com a Diretoria na definição de metas de faturamento, volume, positivação e mix de produtos. Analisar dados de vendas para identificar oportunidades de crescimento, rentabilização e otimização de esforços. Desenvolver e implementar políticas comerciais, incluindo estratégias de precificação, descontos e comissionamento, com base em pesquisas de mercado e análise de concorrência. Planejar a expansão para novos mercados e canais de venda.
  3. Execução e Trade Marketing: Garantir excelência na execução no ponto de venda. Desenvolver ações de trade marketing para aumentar a visibilidade, o giro dos produtos e fortalecer a marca nos canais de venda. Gerenciar o relacionamento com distribuidores, garantindo alinhamento estratégico e desempenho.
  4. Processos e Análise de Dados: Ser o guardião dos KPIs, analisando resultados e reportando à diretoria para tomadas de decisão rápidas e precisas. Participar da transição de gestão manual de pedidos para um sistema automatizado e integrado, colaborando com a equipe interna. Fornecer insights do campo e da equipe de vendas para o planejamento de S&OP, conectando demandas comerciais à capacidade produtiva e logística.

Qualificações e Perfil do Candidato:

  • Experiência Essencial: Sólida experiência em gestão de equipes de vendas externas (representantes comerciais, vendedores), preferencialmente no setor de bens de consumo, higiene e limpeza, ou em distribuidores. Vivência prática em campo, realizando rotas e negociações B2B. Habilidade com dados e indicadores (KPIs). Experiência na definição e implementação de políticas comerciais e ações de trade marketing. Histórico de sucesso em expansão de mercado e contratação de representantes. Conhecimento do mercado de limpeza será um diferencial.
  • Habilidades Comportamentais: Liderança resiliente e inspiradora, capaz de gerenciar perfis diversos pelo exemplo, respeito e foco em objetivos comuns. Inteligência emocional e habilidades de negociação para construir relacionamentos sólidos, mediar conflitos e negociar eficazmente. Perfil "construtor" e "mão na massa": proativo, confortável em ambientes com poucos processos, enxergando oportunidades de criá-los e implementá-los com a equipe. Visão de dono: age com autonomia, responsabilidade e senso de urgência na resolução de problemas e captura de oportunidades. Disciplina e organização essenciais para rotinas eficazes em ambientes dinâmicos.

ENTREGAS PARA ESTA DEMANDA:

Analisar o conteúdo bruto e roteiros para garantir a pertinência temática e a atualidade das informações. Realizar correções de erros conceituais. Propor melhorias para o entendimento do conteúdo. Analisar a linearidade e coesão do texto, adicionando exemplos práticos para facilitar a compreensão e a contextualização. Assegurar que o produto final esteja conforme a expectativa do cliente e do público, com linguagem e visual adequados, conforme especificações do curso. A Globo é feita de gente que quer fazer diferente, fazer junto, fazer o futuro.

Novos modelos de negócios digitais estão sendo pensados e desenvolvidos, buscando nos aproximar cada vez mais do usuário e dos seus desejos. As oportunidades de novos negócios também trazem a chance e o desafio de construirmos novos times data-driven e que coloquem o consumidor no centro das nossas decisões.

Criamos ambientes onde todas as pessoas são incluídas, acolhidas e valorizadas. Nos empenhamos em ser uma Globo cada vez mais diversa, em representatividade e pensamento, aprendendo uns com os outros e estimulando a criatividade e inovação.

A área de Negócios em Publicidade do Globoplay tem como objetivo fazer a gestão do negócio de publicidade da plataforma, buscando a melhor entrega em projetos publicitários de forma a garantir equilíbrio entre as necessidades do mercado anunciante, a experiência do usuário impactado por publicidade e as diretrizes e objetivos de negócios do Globoplay.

Como será seu dia a dia

  • Acompanhar os resultados de receita e performance de vendas, propondo ações de melhoria;
  • Desenvolver diagnósticos e análises baseadas em dados para identificar oportunidades de evolução das ofertas publicitárias;
  • Monitorar e gerir o inventário publicitário disponível, garantindo o equilíbrio entre demanda comercial e experiência do usuário, suportando o processo de orçamento e projeção de inventário;
  • Propor otimizações de inventário com base em métricas como impressões monetizáveis, ocupação e alcance de usuários;
  • Liderar o processo de monitoramento de concorrência para profundo entendimento sob fortalezas e fraquezas (ex: posicionamento, produtos, formatos, canais de venda e preços);
  • Cocriar junto à NIP ao posicionamento de Globoplay como ativo de mídia relevante e inovador para o mercado publicitário (incluindo Upfront, defesas comerciais e narrativas para marcas e agências);
  • Propor cards de atualizações e performance de resultados para time comercial e mercado;
  • Compor relatórios e apoiar materiais executivos.

Do que você precisa

  • Formação superior completa em Administração, Comunicação, Publicidade, Economia ou Marketing desejável;
  • Pós-graduação desejável em Gestão de Negócios, Ciência de Dados ou Marketing;
  • Conhecimento da indústria de streaming, dos modelos de negócios de publicidades, e seus desafios de crescimento;
  • Forte capacidade analítica para interpretar dados para a criação de critérios e alvos de geração de valor ao consumidor e ao negócio, e na sequência traduzir em planos de ação;
  • Experiência no mercado publicitário brasileiro, com domínio de dados de pesquisa de mídia e métricas de campanhas publicitárias, gestão de orçamento e metas de receita, análises de mercado, preferencialmente em serviços digitais de conteúdo.
  • Conhecimento do mercado publicitário brasileiro, capaz de fazer análises e diagnósticos sobre as necessidades dos anunciantes e do negócio;
  • Tenacidade comercial e espírito empreendedor;
  • Inglês avançado desejável.

Por que vir para Globo

Vem e vamos criar histórias e tecnologias juntos.

Na Globo, o encontro de histórias com tecnologia move um time diverso e apaixonado por inovação.

A gente tem a chance de aproximar os brasileiros, criando novas formas de se conectar com eles.

Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better.

Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full time Manager of IT.

The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud-based IT systems and tools.

A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security-first environments.

The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code. But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help.

You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.

You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever-changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.

You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast moving and highly execution-oriented team.

You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

The ideal candidate is an excellent communicator and fast learner who is looking for a supportive environment to continue to grow their IT skills and expertise.

This role will report to the Director of IT.

About the Role

You will be customer-facing, and the first line of support; you own support, and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.

You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment.

You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.

You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background.

You’ll support and manage SaaS applications — Google Workspace (GSuite), Slack, Jamf Pro, Jamf Protect, Jamf Connect, Okta, Jira, etc.

You will work with and manage Mac endpoint and mobile device management tools — MDM, EMM, Jamf, etc.

You’ll own and contribute to improvements on IDP and SSO tools (GSuite, Okta, etc.)

You’ll detail your solutions, craft help articles and automate busywork.

Manage, respond to, and fix critical incidents and issues as needed, through to completion.

You’re comfortable juggling help desk tickets and can effectively prioritise them.

You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

You’ll set and work to your own objective and key results with minimal direction, and can align them to the team and the company goals.

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Ability to integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • Knowledge of working with APIs and integrating systems.
  • Remote support experience to people in multiple countries and time zones; familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Excellent communication skills across all media; can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.
  • Writing skills in tickets, email or Slack.
  • Clear, friendly, and concise writing style; sensitive to different cultures.
  • A desire to provide a magical experience for others — when they win, you win.
  • Knowledge of PGP and commitment to security.
  • Understanding of networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.
  • Ability to troubleshoot according to OSI model layers methodically.
  • Self‑management and ability to scope projects, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills.
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and making decisions without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (experience with these environments). No certifications required.
  • Experience using tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to reduce effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values. The ideal candidate will: have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.

Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.

Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.

Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.

Have worked in a remote environment before.

Taste of What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.

Comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!

Competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.

Ownership in the company. Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy.

Opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

A career that provides you with purpose in your job.

We remove barriers so you love what you do.

We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team by emailing ****** for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

Pharmacovigilance Associate - Brazil - Remote

ICON plc is a world‑leading healthcare intelligence and clinical research organization. We’re proud to foster an inclusive environment driving innovation and excellence, and we welcome you to join us on our mission to shape the future of clinical development.

We are currently seeking a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate to join our diverse and dynamic team. As a Senior Pharmacovigilance Associate at ICON, you will be instrumental in ensuring the safety and efficacy of pharmaceutical products by managing and overseeing pharmacovigilance activities. You will collaborate with cross‑functional teams to ensure compliance with regulatory requirements and to maintain the highest standards of patient safety.

What You Will Be Doing:

  • Leading the collection, evaluation, and processing of adverse event reports to ensure timely and accurate reporting in accordance with regulatory guidelines and company policies.
  • Conducting thorough data analysis and interpretation of safety data, identifying trends and potential safety signals that require further investigation.
  • Preparing and submitting comprehensive periodic safety update reports (PSURs) and other regulatory documents, ensuring compliance with international regulations.
  • Collaborating with medical and clinical teams to assess the clinical relevance of reported adverse events and contribute to risk management activities.
  • Overseeing the maintenance and integrity of pharmacovigilance databases, ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with data management standards.
  • Providing training and mentorship to junior team members on pharmacovigilance processes, regulatory requirements, and best practices.
  • Engaging in audits and inspections conducted by regulatory authorities, ensuring readiness and compliance with all relevant pharmacovigilance requirements.
  • Staying informed on evolving regulatory guidelines and industry best practices to continually enhance the pharmacovigilance processes within the organization.

Your Profile:

  • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, pharmacy, nursing, or a related field. An advanced degree is preferred.
  • Extensive experience in pharmacovigilance or drug safety, with a strong understanding of relevant regulations and industry standards.
  • Proven ability to manage the pharmacovigilance process effectively, including adverse event reporting and signal detection.
  • Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with the ability to interpret complex data and make informed recommendations.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across cross‑functional teams.
  • Proficiency in pharmacovigilance databases and data management systems, as well as Microsoft Office Suite.
  • Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities in a fast‑paced environment.
  • Commitment to maintaining confidentiality and handling sensitive patient information with discretion.

Our success depends on the quality of our people. That’s why we’ve made it a priority to build a diverse culture that rewards high performance and nurtures talent.

In addition to your competitive salary, ICON offers a range of additional benefits. Our benefits are designed to be competitive within each country and are focused on well‑being and work life balance opportunities for you and your family.

  • Various annual leave entitlements

  • Life assurance
  • Flexible country‑specific optional benefits, including childcare vouchers, bike purchase schemes, discounted gym memberships, subsidized travel passes, health assessments, among others.

Your Role

The Senior Accountant role is designed for an experienced professional who is ready for the next step in their accounting career. The ideal candidate will be highly motivated, meticulous and enthusiastic with a can‑do attitude. This position is responsible for handling complex accrual‑based accounting tasks for multiple clients, requiring minimal direction from Controllers. The Senior Accountant must possess strong analytical skills, excellent technical knowledge, and the ability to deliver accurate and timely results. A person in this role is comfortable using relevant knowledge, know‑how and skills to convey clear and concise thoughts and ideas to clients and internal teams, both in written format and during virtual meetings. Adaptability is key to thriving in this fast‑paced environment, as the role demands responsiveness to changing expectations and processes to provide exceptional value to clients.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Maintain books for multiple clients on an accrual basis, often with the help of an Assistant or Accountant as needed
  • Completion of timely and accurate monthly close process and financial reporting, including class reporting, job‑costing, analysis of account categories and defining trends
  • Manage all aspects of the accounts receivable process, including unbilled revenue, deferred income, and bad debt allowances
  • Manage all aspects of the accounts payable process, including vendor bills, and online payments
  • Prepare cash management flash report
  • Responsible for properly tracking inventory and identifying unusual or unexpected results
  • Responsible for fixed asset and intangible asset management, including maintaining depreciation and amortization schedules and posting related journal entries for acquisitions and disposals
  • Payroll processing using Intuit or other third‑party payroll applications and review quarterly and annual reports such as: W‑2, W‑3, 941, and state U/E. Ability to identify and resolve payroll issues
  • Support management with gathering documentation for budgets, forecasts and annual audit
  • Record and maintain financing transactions, such as loans and investments, including proper classification of short‑term and long‑term commitments
  • Evaluate lease contracts to determine short‑term/long‑term classification
  • Calculate and prepare tax forms and payments, such as sales & use tax, property tax returns, and client‑specific business tax and franchise tax filings
  • Assist with review and preparation of 1099s and year‑end payroll inclusions
  • Updating and maintaining data for established KPIs
  • Responsible for updating various dashboards and reports and budgets in Jirav
  • Take full ownership of writing and updating the Client Procedure Manual to ensure it is complete and accurate at all times
  • Use critical thinking to research issues and provide meaningful solutions
  • Independently interpret, research, and apply knowledge to resolve technical accounting issues
  • Embraces various technologies and applications to make process improvement recommendations
  • Be a proactive change‑agent; take the lead in identifying cumbersome processes and explore options of applying new technology to increase job efficiency and effectiveness
  • Lead client meetings and provide a high‑level of customer service
  • Partner with client third‑party advisors for exchange of data and reports
  • Tracks time on client engagements and manages work to meet deadlines within established time budgets; able to explain budget variances
  • Assists on special projects and additional responsibilities as needed
  • Pursues opportunities for continuous learning

Essential Skills & Experience

  • 5+ years performing full‑charge bookkeeping and 2+ years using QuickBooks and/or NetSuite Software, including daily transaction processing, monthly close and financial reporting
  • Advanced knowledge of fundamental bookkeeping and accounting principles, practices and procedures, including enhanced levels of: financial reporting and analysis, budgeting, prepaids/accruals, capitalization, financing, job costing and regulatory tax requirements
  • Possess a very high degree of accuracy and attention to detail
  • Self‑directed, highly motivated and proactive
  • Highly organized and process‑driven
  • Excellent problem‑solving, critical thinking and analytical skills
  • Proven experience meeting deadlines

Nós atuamos no segmento de energia elétrica do Brasil e temos uma história sólida, desde 1912, de contribuição para o desenvolvimento das cidades e estados que atendemos por meio de soluções em geração, transmissão, distribuição, comercialização de energia e prestação de serviços.

title: Accounts Payable Specialist
description:
TRM Labs is a blockchain intelligence company committed to fighting crime and creating a safer world. By leveraging blockchain data, threat intelligence, and advanced analytics, our products empower governments, financial institutions, and crypto businesses to combat illicit activity and global security threats. At TRM, you’ll join a mission‑driven, fast‑paced team made up of experts in law enforcement, data science, engineering, and financial intelligence, tackling complex global challenges daily. Whether analyzing blockchain data, developing cutting‑edge tools, or collaborating with global organizations, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful and lasting impact.

We are seeking an Accounts Payable Specialist to play a critical role in ensuring accurate, timely payments and building scalable procurement processes at TRM. As a fully remote, global company, TRM requires an AP function that is both efficient and strategic—balancing day‑to‑day execution with process improvements that strengthen vendor relationships, support healthy cash flow, and raise standards for financial discipline.

You will join TRM’s high‑performing Finance team, which leads with ownership, accountability, and a commitment to excellence. Partnering closely with Finance, HR, and cross‑functional teams, you’ll ensure invoices are processed on time, vendors are supported seamlessly, and AP systems evolve to meet the needs of a fast‑growing organization.

The impact you will have:

  • Own payment operations : Consistently achieve >95% on‑time and accurate payments while completing AP close within target timelines to support cash flow visibility.
  • Enhance vendor & employee experience : Manage Zip effectively, onboard vendors quickly, and resolve invoice/payment inquiries while maintaining >90% compliance with card submissions.
  • Streamline procurement : Develop and implement procurement processes, including vendor negotiations, policy rollouts, and measurable cost savings that establish best practices at TRM.
  • Drive system & process improvements : Identify and implement automation or workflow enhancements to reduce manual work, strengthen liability forecasting, and improve scalability.
  • Support month‑end close : Prepare and review accruals, manage prepaid expense amortization, and reconcile accounts payable to ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting.
  • Partner cross‑functionally : Provide timely, accurate AP reporting and collaborate with stakeholders across Finance, HR, and other teams to ensure a seamless procurement and payment experience.

What we’re looking for:

  • 3–5 years of accounts payable experience, ideally in a SaaS, startup, or high‑growth environment.
  • Strong understanding of AP processes and procurement workflows; experience with Zip, Airbase, Netsuite or similar systems is a plus.
  • Exceptional attention to detail and accuracy, with a proven track record of processing payments and invoices reliably and on time.
  • Strong analytical and problem‑solving skills to identify process gaps, reconcile issues, and recommend improvements.
  • Clear, proactive communicator who builds trusted relationships with vendors and internal stakeholders.
  • Ownership mindset, able to manage multiple AP responsibilities simultaneously while driving continuous improvement.

Learn about TRM Speed in this position:

  • High‑Priority Requests: For P1 items, able to immediately jump in and resolve employee/vendor requests for urgent, time‑sensitive purchases within the same day, without compromising accuracy.
  • Policy Rollouts: When a new procurement or AP policy is introduced, able to implement the change in systems and workflows within 1 week of rollout.
  • Vendor Invoice Processing & Communication: Upload vendor invoices to the system within 24–48 hours of receipt and respond to vendor email inquiries within 1 business day.

Life at TRM Labs

Leadership Principles

Our Leadership Principles shape everything we do—how we make decisions, collaborate, and operate day to day.

  • Impact‑Oriented Trailblazer – We put customers first, driving for speed, focus, and adaptability.
  • Master Craftsperson – We prioritize speed, high standards, and distributed ownership.
  • Inspiring Colleague – We value humility, candor, and a one‑team mindset.

Accelerate your Career

At TRM, you’ll do work that matters—disrupting terrorist networks, recovering stolen funds, and protecting people around the world. You will:

  • Work alongside top experts and learn every day.
  • Embrace a growth mindset with development opportunities tailored to your role.
  • Take on high‑impact challenges in a fast‑paced, collaborative environment.
  • Thrive in a culture of coaching, where feedback is fast, direct, and built to help you level up.

What to Expect at TRM

TRM moves fast—really fast. We operate with urgency, ownership, and high standards. As a result, you’ll be joining a team that’s highly engaged, mission‑driven, and constantly evolving.

To support this intensity, we’re also intentional about rest and recharge. We offer generous benefits, including PTO, Holidays, and Parental Leave for full time employees.

That said, TRM may not be the right fit for everyone . If you’re optimizing for work life balance, we encourage you to:

  • Ask your interviewers how they personally approach balance within their teams, and
  • Reflect on whether this is the right season in your life to join a high‑velocity environment.
  • Be honest with yourself about what energizes you—and what drains you.

We’re upfront about this because we want every new team member to thrive—not just survive.

The Stakes Are Real

Our work has direct, real‑world impact:

  • Jumping online after hours to support urgent government requests tracing ransomware payments.
  • Delivering actionable insights during terrorist financing investigations.
  • Collaborating across time zones in real time during a major global hack.
  • Building new processes in days, not weeks, to stop criminals before they cash out.
  • Analyzing blockchain data to recover stolen savings and dismantle trafficking networks.

Thrive as a Global Team

As a remote‑first company, TRM Labs is built for global collaboration.

  • We cultivate a strong remote culture through clear communication, thorough documentation, and meaningful relationships.
  • We invest in offsites, regional meetups, virtual coffee chats, and onboarding buddies to foster collaboration.
  • By prioritizing trust and belonging, we harness the strengths of a global team while staying aligned with our mission and values.

Join our mission!

We’re looking for team members who thrive in fast‑paced, high‑impact environments and love building from the ground up. TRM is remote‑first, with an exceptionally talented global team. If you enjoy solving tough problems and seeing your work make a difference for billions of people, we want you here. Don’t worry if your experience doesn’t perfectly match a job description— we value passion, problem‑solving, and unique career paths. If you’re excited about TRM’s mission, we want to hear from you.

Recruitment agencies

TRM Labs does not accept unsolicited agency resumes. Please do not forward resumes to TRM employees. TRM Labs is not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes and will not pay fees to any third‑party agency or company without a signed agreement.

Opportunity

We are looking for an experienced engineer to join the Cybersecurity/IT Engineering team as a full‑time Manager of IT.
The ideal candidate is comfortable wearing many different hats including supporting end users, managing endpoints, automating identity and access management, and administering cloud‑based IT systems and tools.
A successful candidate will have demonstrated previous success in similar role(s) in rapidly growing, security‑first environments.
The right person is passionate about automation, scripting, and building infrastructure as code.
But, just as passionate about helping end users who are in need of help. You will be a participant in the design, implementation and management of our growing corporate cloud first infrastructure and networks.
You will have a passion for innovation and creative problem solving, as well as be adaptable to the ever‑changing landscape of the corporate infrastructure environment.
You will need to be a highly motivated, dependable and an experienced technologist who shares our passion and wants to be a part of a fast‑moving and highly execution‑oriented team. You will work closely with your Cybersecurity/IT peers and key stakeholder teams, including, but not limited to, Customer Success, Marketing, Engineering and HR.

About the Role

This role will report to the Director of IT. You will be customer‑facing, and the first line of support; you own support and you are passionate about providing an outstanding support experience to our employees — via Slack, Jira, etc. We’re all Mac.
You are a pro at troubleshooting, using the terminal, and making macOS work in the enterprise. You will be responsible for procuring and delivering technology equipment. You will own the experience of tech onboarding of all new employees as well as tech retrieval of all outgoing employees.
You’ll design, test, build, and document programs and policies and tools, and contribute improvements to existing knowledge with your experience and background. You’ll work on projects over sprints, and detail your work in tools like Jira (you’re experienced with agile methods and sprints).

What You Bring to Ledn

  • 7+ years in SaaS systems administration: Jamf Pro, Google Workspace, Okta, Slack, Jira, Netsuite.
  • Ability to create automations using bash, zsh, python, etc.
  • Ability to utilise open‑source tools such as Nudge, CIS Benchmark scripts, SplashBuddy, Munki, etc.
  • Do you integrate SSO into Okta, create workflows in Okta.
  • You know how to work with APIs, and integrate one system to another.
  • You’ve provided remote support to people in multiple countries, across time zones, and you’re familiar with shipping and receiving hardware and customs.
  • Unusually great communication skills across all media — you can make your ideas clear, and you can help people who might be frustrated or time‑poor without losing your cool.

  • You understand networking fundamentals and basic troubleshooting — TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, VLANs, routing and switching.

  • You can self‑manage, and can accurately scope your project, priorities, and work across multiple teams.
  • Strong organisational and task‑management skills are critical.
  • You’re comfortable dealing with ambiguity, and sometimes making the right decision without all the data.

Nice to Haves

  • Some familiarity with AWS (you will not need certifications, but you will have used these environments a bit.)
  • You’ve used tools like GAM and command‑line interfaces to do lots of work with less effort.
  • Jamf certifications, Okta certifications, Google Workspace certifications.

Culture Fit

We’re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.
The ideal candidate will:
• Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high‑growth, fast‑paced environment.
• Have a builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IT practices.
• Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
• Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
• Have worked in a remote environment before.
• Taste of What We Provide.

What We Provide

As one of the world’s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities. A comprehensive, best‑in‑class total rewards package that starts on your first day!
We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve. Ownership in the company.
Through shared equity, Ledn employees are stakeholders in the company and the future of the digital economy. We offer every employee the opportunity to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days (subject to restrictions).

description:
ABOUT HAPPY MONEY

Happy Money is a leading consumer finance company dedicated to helping people achieve their goals through responsible lending. Through its fully-digital platform, Happy Money partners with credit unions, banks and asset managers to originate high-quality credit solutions, diversify their portfolios and expand their impact and reach nationwide.

Backed by investors like TruStage Ventures, Happy Money enables financial institutions to grow as a force for good in their communities while helping people use money as a tool for their happiness. Learn more at happymoney.com.

ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Senior Lead Analyst in the Pricing & Conversion team at Happy Money, you will be responsible for developing, analyzing, and optimizing our application conversion and pricing strategy. Sitting within the Risk and Analytics team, you will own analytics and strategy changes, periodic reporting, and initiatives that enhance our funnel conversion and optimize leads.

You will work cross-functionally with Credit Operations, Product, and Engineering to drive proactive, data-driven strategies that support responsible growth for Happy Money and our lending partners.

Pricing:

  • Develop and implement credit strategies leveraging data, machine learning models and advanced analytics tools to mitigate losses and maintain excellent customer experience.

ABOUT YOU

description:
Brand & Marketing Designer (Part-Time / Fractional)

Remote-first, worldwide applicants welcome. Part‑time freelance (5–20 h/week) with a clear path to full‑time within 12 months based on impact.

Reports to Founder/Marketing/Head of Design.

About The Opportunity

We are building a differentiated brand in a brutally competitive AI/SaaS market. This is not a “make it pretty” gig. We want a designer with exceptional taste, strong opinions, and the instincts to ship visuals that move metrics.

What You’ll Do

  • Own day‑to‑day marketing design: ad creatives, product marketing animations, landing pages, websites, email visuals, partner assets.
  • Evolve and guard our brand system (typography, color, illustration, motion, component libraries) across web and product‑adjacent surfaces.
  • Turn complex AI features into clear, conversion‑ready visuals (diagrams, product mockups, short motion snippets).
  • Rapidly prototype A/B test variants; ship multiple creative angles per week.
  • Build reusable templates for speed (social sets, launch kits, webinar packs, sales one‑pagers).
  • Collaborate on campaign concepts end‑to‑end: insight → moodboard → concept → production → iteration.
  • Maintain a tidy Figma workspace (components, tokens, documentation) so others can self‑serve.

Success Looks Like

  • Asset turnaround under 48 h for priority requests; weekly creative batch drops.
  • A cohesive brand system used across marketing and sales with near‑zero rework.

Who You Are

  • 6+ years hands‑on design experience in SaaS/AI (agency or in‑house).
  • Exceptional taste: refined typography, layout discipline, restraint where it matters, edge where it counts.
  • Deep interest in current design trends in tech/SaaS/AI with references at hand.
  • Not afraid to be bold; can defend strong creative while staying coachable.
  • Fast‑paced, passionate, easy to work with. Low‑ego collaborator who communicates crisply.
  • Tools: Figma & WordPress/Elementor power user; Adobe Illustrator as needed. Bonus: light motion (After Effects or Figma video exports).

Bonus Points

  • 2–4+ years in marketing/advertising environments (performance creative, concepting, storytelling).
  • Production of quick micro‑motion (feature reveals, UI walkthroughs, ad loops).
  • Understanding of performance marketing basics (hook hierarchy, thumb‑stop, offer framing, mobile‑first).
  • Experience building componentized design systems for marketing.

What We Offer

  • Start part‑time freelance; earn full‑time seat in = 12 months through results.
  • Direct access to founders; zero bureaucracy; ownership from day one.
  • Work that’s seen by millions, not buried in decks.

Portfolio & Application

Portfolio with 6–10 pieces relevant to SaaS/AI marketing (ads, LPs, campaign sets, brand work). For 3 highlights, add 2–3 lines on goal, your role, outcome (metrics if possible). Short note on brands you admire in AI/SaaS and why (2–3 bullets). Optional: a 30–60s Loom walking through one project.

Apply via email to ******. Share your LinkedIn and portfolio. If you’re serious, add the optional Loom—personality matters.

description:
Quem somos nós?

Somos um ecossistema de transformação digital que combina tecnologia e visão estratégica para escalar resultados e aumentar o valor entregue aos nossos clientes. Nosso propósito é impactar positivamente pessoas e negócios, exponencializando cada um para atingir seu máximo potencial. Respeitamos todas as diferenças e criamos um espaço aberto e livre para você ter autonomia, expor suas ideias, aprender com os erros, se conectar com outras pessoas e gerar mudanças ao seu redor.

Se você deseja estar em um ambiente colaborativo, desafiador e que incentiva você a sempre evoluir e ser o protagonista da sua história, aqui é o seu lugar

Antes de avançarmos, é importante você saber que:

  • Contratação: CLT
  • Modelo de Trabalho: Remoto
  • Horário: das 9h às 12h e das 13h às 18h. A jornada é flexível conforme agendas e entregas.
  • Etapas do Processo: Composto por 3 a 4 etapas, com um tempo médio de até 03 dias úteis entre uma etapa e outra.
  • Meios de Comunicação: Utilizamos E-mail e WhatsApp. Certifique-se de que essas informações estejam corretas no momento de inscrição para evitar falhas na comunicação.

O que buscamos?

Estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead experiente para liderar o desenvolvimento técnico de soluções baseadas em inteligência artificial conversacional. Quem ocupar esta posição será responsável por guiar o time de engenharia, definir arquiteturas escaláveis e atuar mão na massa no desenvolvimento de serviços Python e integrações com modelos de linguagem (LLMs) para construção de jornadas conversacionais inteligentes.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Liderar o time técnico, promovendo boas práticas de engenharia e arquitetura de software.
  • Participar ativamente do desenvolvimento de aplicações e microserviços em Python.
  • Definir e evoluir a arquitetura de plataformas conversacionais baseadas em LLMs (Large Language Models).
  • Colaborar com times de produto e IA para desenhar jornadas conversacionais complexas, integradas a sistemas externos.
  • Garantir a qualidade técnica, performance e segurança das soluções.
  • Apoiar o time em decisões técnicas e revisões de código.
  • Avaliar e implementar novas ferramentas e frameworks que melhorem a produtividade e a escalabilidade da plataforma.

Para cumprir esse desafio, você precisa ter:

  • Experiência sólida como Tech Lead, Líder Técnico ou Arquiteto de Software.
  • Domínio de Python e boas práticas de desenvolvimento (PEP8, tipagem, testes, etc.).
  • Experiência em projetos com LLMs (OpenAI, Anthropic, Mistral ou similares).
  • Vivência na criação de fluxos/jornadas conversacionais com uso de LLMs, LangChain ou frameworks equivalentes.
  • Conhecimento em APIs REST e arquitetura de microserviços.
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e/ou NoSQL (ex: PostgreSQL, Redis).
  • Familiaridade com Git, CI/CD e metodologias ágeis.

Você irá se destacar se:

  • Tiver experiência com orquestração de fluxos conversacionais (Rasa, Botpress, ou soluções proprietárias).
  • Possuir conhecimento em engenharia de prompts e modelagem de contexto conversacional.
  • Tiver experiência com serviços em nuvem (AWS, GCP ou Azure).
  • Já tiver trabalhado com arquitetura orientada a eventos e filas de mensagens (Kafka, RabbitMQ, etc.).
  • Dominar containerização (Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Tiver interesse em IA aplicada à automação de atendimento e agentes inteligentes.

O que oferecemos aos nossos Builders?

  • Auxílio Alimentação (VA/VR) no cartão Caju;
  • Auxílio Home-Office no cartão Caju;
  • Programa de Pontos Flexíveis em seu Caju - um valor fléxivel para você usar como você quiser;

Além disso, a Eurofins é um dos principais players emergentes em testes de diagnóstico clínico especializados na Europa e nos EUA.

Os números-chave do grupo são aproximadamente: Faturamento de 3,8 bilhões de euros, mais de 800 laboratórios em 47 países e cerca de 45.000 funcionários.

Descrição do emprego

Executar as técnicas analíticas descritas nos procedimentos da empresa, com análise crítica dos resultados, atendendo aos prazos, mantendo a organização e zelando pela segurança e integridade de todos.

  • Realizar e supervisionar as diferentes etapas analíticas, incluindo pesagem, extração e homogeneização, por exemplo;
  • Treinar novos colaboradores e acompanhar auxiliares e estagiários em procedimentos quando solicitado pelo Coordenador do Setor
  • Incluir os resultados avaliados, repetições e análises adicionais no sistema (de acordo com a respectiva linha de negócio), bem como registrar informações pertinentes;
  • Realizar a solicitação de compra de materiais para o laboratório no sistema com supervisão da Coordenação, se necessário;
  • Auxiliar o envio de materiais para calibração;
  • Realizar o acompanhamento e orientação dos Assistentes, Auxiliares e Estagiários;
  • Revisar e criar novos documentos no sistema de Gestão da Qualidade;
  • Participar de forma supervisionada nas validações, no que tange as etapas analíticas;
  • Comunicar com a área de cadastro (Login/Triagem) quanto às amostras em processamento, seguida de impressão de mapa de trabalho. Armazenar essas amostras de forma organizada no setor.
  • Auxiliar na checagem de resultados analísticos / análises críticas;
  • Executar os ensaios de proficiência;
  • Comunicar qualquer problema na rotina do laboratório junto ao Analista Sênior ou Coordenação;
  • Realizar as tarefas gerais do laboratório de acordo com a divisão de tarefas definidas pelo Coordenador que pode incluir: preparo de materiais (soluções, tampões, meios de cultura, soluções padrão), checagem de temperaturas, validade das soluções e reagentes em uso;

Ideal candidates will have strong systems thinking and a passion for automation, with a deep understanding of DevOps principles and tooling. If you are passionate about DevOps, infrastructure-as-code, platform observability, and integrated release management—and want to make a tangible impact across client delivery teams—read on.

Role responsibilities

  • Design, implement, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using Bitbucket and Jenkins to support code deployment across SFCC, Fluent Commerce, and SFMC.
  • Build and maintain platform-specific Run Books, SOPs, and KEDB documentation to enable consistent incident handling and operational readiness.
  • Manage and optimize infrastructure observability using ELK (Elasticsearch, Logstash, Kibana) and integrated logging tools to ensure proactive monitoring and issue resolution.
  • Coordinate environment management and deployment automation across platforms such as OpenText DAM, Salsify PIM, OneTrust, and ServiceNow (SNOW).
  • Administer and enforce DevOps best practices across ServiceNow ITSM, ensuring integration of incident, change, and release workflows with development activities.
  • Support secure, compliant, and scalable platform operations through automated job execution, monitoring alerts, and rollback strategies.

We want all new hires to succeed in their roles at Valtech. That's why we've outlined the job requirements below. To be considered for this role, it's important that you meet all Minimum Qualifications. If you do not meet all of the Preferred Qualifications, we still encourage you to apply.

  • 4+ years of experience in DevOps or platform engineering roles.
  • Hands-on experience with Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFCC) and CI/CD tooling such as Bitbucket and Jenkins.
  • Proficiency managing log pipelines and observability stacks, particularly with ELK.
  • Familiarity with digital commerce systems like Fluent Commerce, SFMC, OpenText DAM, and Salsify PIM.
  • Experience supporting ITSM processes and tooling, including ServiceNow (SNOW).
  • Ability to write and maintain operational documentation (SOPs, KEDBs, runbooks).
  • Comfortable with scripting for automation (e.g., Bash, Python, Groovy).

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience designing and managing enterprise CI/CD pipelines across multiple digital experience platforms.
  • Familiarity with regulatory frameworks or compliance standards (e.g., GDPR, SOC 2) in DevOps processes.
  • Exposure to headless commerce architecture and microservices-based systems.
  • Experience integrating monitoring and alerting systems with platforms like PagerDuty or Slack.
  • Experience in infrastructure-as-code tools (e.g., Terraform, Ansible).
  • Comfortable collaborating across engineering, QA, and business stakeholders.

Your process

After submitting your application, you will hear from a member of our Talent Acquisition team if your skills and experience match the position. Be mindful of recruitment fraud by only replying and engaging with email contacts that end with the @valtech.com or @kinandcarta.com domain.

We strive to create an inclusive environment for all candidates. If you have any specific requirements or need reasonable adjustments to participate in the application or interview process, please let us know at .

Valtech is the experience innovation company that exists to unlock a better way to experience the world. By blending crafts, categories, and cultures, our global team of 6,500 professionals in more than 60 offices help brands unlock value in a digitally accelerated world. At the intersection of insights and perspectives, we leverage the power of data, AI, creativity, and technology to achieve experience innovation for many of the world’s best-known organisations, including L’Oreal, NatWest, DWP, P&G, Volkswagen, and US department of Agriculture.

Valtech will always be recognized not just for the quality of the work we deliver, but for all the amazing people that make it happen. We are seeking a full‑time Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin‑backed loan platform.

Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both tactical improvements and long‑term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems.

  • Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams.
  • Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services.
  • Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD.
  • Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features.
  • Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications.
  • Enhance existing Cognito‑based identity architecture with stronger, phishing‑resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens).
  • Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows.
  • Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Design enclave‑based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads.
  • Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs.
  • Migrate high‑value operations into enclave environments.
  • Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least‑privilege IAM and secure key management.
  • Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring).
  • Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks.
  • Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.

Qualifications

  • 10+ years of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud‑native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands‑on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review.
  • Understanding of software supply chain.
  • Deep understanding of Linux internals.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user‑facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.

Culture Fit

  • Passion for progress, adaptability, resilience, comfortable navigating ambiguity.
  • Builder’s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrates integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Experience working in a remote environment.

Benefits and Opportunity

Ledn offers a comprehensive rewards package, competitive PTO, ownership equity, and the flexibility to work remotely anywhere in the world for up to 180 days.

We are an equal‑opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

description:
We are hiring multiple Software Engineers to join the Microsoft 365 team. These are remote positions, allowing you to work from the comfort of your home! Microsoft 365 is the fastest-growing cloud services business at Microsoft. It brings together cloud versions of our most trusted communication and collaboration products—Exchange, SharePoint, OneDrive, and Teams—with the desktop suite of Office products in an always up-to-date, integrated service offering. Since its launch, the service has helped millions of information workers in small, medium, and large enterprises use Microsoft’s best productivity solutions via the cloud. It now extends the same capabilities to consumer communication and collaboration products.

Software Engineers at Microsoft play a key role in driving technical details for their product teams. They design and implement services that are high-scale, low-latency, always-on, and cost-effective to maintain and operate. They collaborate with principal engineers and architects to design components and influence common development patterns.   • Promote knowledge sharing and contribute to onboarding documentation.
  • Participate in the on-call rotation to monitor service health and manage incidents.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering OR equivalent experience.
  • At least 1 year of experience in software design and backend service development.
  • 1+ year(s) of hands-on experience in an object-oriented language such as C++, C#, Java, Python, or equivalent experience with C.
  • Global collaboration is integral to our work at Microsoft, and proficiency in English is essential for effective communication in this role.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Master’s degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
  • Ability to communicate technical details clearly.
  • Experience in DevOps for live services or application frameworks.
  • Cloud services experience; Azure experience is highly desirable.
  • Strong analytical skills and a structured approach to software design.
  • Passion for building reliable, well-tested services.
  • Experience with Agile and iterative development processes.

Interpersonal Skills

  • Growth mindset: eager to learn, embrace challenges, persist through setbacks, and learn from feedback and others’ success.
  • Commitment to diversity and inclusion: fostering a culture where everyone can be authentic and heard.
  • Confident and articulate in expressing ideas to diverse audiences.
  • Strong sense of ownership and accountability, with the ability to meet deadlines and manage stakeholder expectations.
  • Self-motivated and collaborative across teams and organizations.

Formação superior em Jornalismo, Comunicação Social ou áreas correlatas. Oportunidades de desenvolvimento de carreira. Ambiente de trabalho inovador e colaborativo.

title: Full Stack Developer "982043"

Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

title: Desenvolvimento de Negócios Globais - Especialistas em Varejo
description:
Se você já liderou no varejo - na loja ou na sede - queremos falar com você.


Sim, somos uma empresa de tecnologia.


Não, você não precisa ter experiência em tecnologia.


Na STOREE.AI, criamos uma plataforma que permite que os gerentes se dupliquem em uma versão com inteligência artificial - um gêmeo digital capaz de liderar equipes, atribuir tarefas, acompanhar KPIs e treinar colaboradores.


Já somos utilizados por mais de 100 redes de lojas.


A tecnologia funciona.


Agora precisamos de pessoas que entendem de varejo para ajudar outros a entender como fazer isso funcionar para eles.


Por que a experiência em varejo é importante:


Nossa plataforma é ampla - ela pode fazer muita coisa.


Mas o que funciona bem para uma rede pode ser completamente diferente para outra.


Uma rede de cosméticos precisa de ferramentas diferentes das de um supermercado.


Um diretor de VM enxerga valor em funcionalidades diferentes das que importam para um head de RH ou de operações.


É por isso que não queremos vendedores.


Queremos profissionais de varejo que possam:


  • Entender as necessidades de uma rede
  • Guiá-los na criação do seu próprio gestor com IA
  • Ajudar nosso time interno a posicionar a solução certa para cada marca
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não jargões tecnológicos


Este é um desenvolvimento de negócios com profundidade - porque conhecer o varejo é o que faz tudo isso funcionar.


O que você vai realmente fazer:


  • Construir uma carteira de varejistas relevantes
  • Usar nossas ferramentas de IA (nós te ensinamos) para iniciar conversas
  • Explicar como a STOREE.AI resolve os desafios específicos de cada negócio
  • Guiar o processo ou repassá-lo para nosso time quando necessário
  • Ajudar a moldar o ajuste do produto internamente - você será nosso olhar de varejo


Você não vai fazer pitch.

Vai conectar, guiar e traduzir entre dois mundos.


Para quem é essa oportunidade:


  • Líderes distritais e regionais
  • Profissionais de sede nas áreas de operações, treinamento, RH, marketing ou excelência no varejo
  • Pessoas que lideraram operações de loja, VM ou experiência do cliente
  • Qualquer pessoa que entende como gerenciar lojas - e quer dar o próximo passo na carreira


Se você já disse: “A tecnologia não entende como é a realidade aqui na ponta” - nós concordamos.


É por isso que queremos você do nosso lado.


O que oferecemos:


  • Treinamento completo - não é necessária experiência em tecnologia
  • Trabalho remoto, com horários flexíveis
  • Comissões por resultados + possibilidade de efetivação em tempo integral
  • Trabalhar com uma empresa prestes a escalar globalmente
  • Fazer parte de algo real - nada de teoria


Isso não é um emprego. É a sua segunda carreira.

De especialista em varejo a líder em tecnologia.

De gerenciar equipes a liderar transformações.


Acesse nosso site:

Sobre a BRQ Digital


Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.


Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.


BRQ WAY


No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!


É isso que queremos, com nosso Programa de Diversidade e Inclusão trabalhamos com dois objetivos: equidade e inclusão, buscamos aumentar a participação dos grupos minoritários, quebrar os vieses inconscientes e expandir a conscientização sobre temas tão importantes para que todos sejam livres para serem quem são.


Vamos transformar juntos! Vem ser fera com a gente.


- O que procuramos?


Buscamos um #fera com espírito empreendedor e que sabe que é o verdadeiro protagonista do seu sucesso! Queremos em nosso time pessoas motivadas por desafios, constante evolução e, claro, que são apaixonadas por tecnologia e transformação!


- Quais as experiência você deve ter:


  • Skills Técnicas: Arquitetura de Sistemas Complexos: Expertise em design de arquiteturas distribuídas, microserviços e sistemas de alta disponibilidade Java/Kotlin Avançado:
  • Domínio profundo do ecossistema JVM, Spring Framework, frameworks reativos (WebFlux, Reactor) e melhores práticas de desenvolvimento
  • Engenharia de Dados: Conhecimento sólido em pipelines de dados, processamento em tempo real/batch, e integração entre sistemas de dados e aplicações AWS Cloud Native:
  • Experiência avançada com serviços AWS (ECS, EKS, Lambda, RDS, DynamoDB, Kinesis, SQS, SNS) e padrões cloud-native DevOps e Infraestrutura: Proficiência em CI/CD, containerização (Docker/Kubernetes), Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Observabilidade: Expertise em monitoring, logging, tracing e métricas (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK Stack, Jaeger)
  • Bancos de Dados: Conhecimento avançado em SQL/NoSQL, otimização de queries e estratégias de persistência Competências de Liderança Humanizada: Mentoria Transformadora: Capacidade de identificar potenciais individuais e criar planos de desenvolvimento personalizados para cada membro da equipe
  • Facilitação de Conflitos: Habilidade para mediar divergências técnicas e interpessoais, transformando tensões em oportunidades de crescimento Comunicação Multinível: Expertise em traduzir complexidades técnicas para diferentes audiências (equipe, stakeholders, gestores) de forma clara e inspiradora
  • Delegação Inteligente: Capacidade de distribuir responsabilidades considerando tanto as necessidades do projeto quanto o desenvolvimento individual de cada pessoa Feedback Construtivo: Habilidade para dar e receber feedback de forma empática, focando no crescimento e na melhoria contínua
  • Liderança de Equipes Técnicas: Mínimo 3 anos liderando equipes de desenvolvimento (5-10 pessoas) Transformação de Equipes: Experiência em reestruturação, upskilling e melhoria de processos de desenvolvimento Projetos de Grande Escala: Participação em projetos que processam alto volume de dados ou atendem milhões de usuários Cultura DevOps: Experiência na implementação de práticas DevOps e cultura de responsabilidade compartilhada Metodologias Ágeis: Proficiência em Scrum, Kanban e práticas de desenvolvimento ágil


- O que temos pra te oferecer?


Mais do que um plano de carreira !


A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:


Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!


Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.


Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.


- E os benefícios?


Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!


- Como é trabalhar na BRQ?


Temos um clima descontraído, diversos programas e eventos internos. Adoramos comemorar! E fazemos isso muito bem! Veja aqui no Youtube: youtube.com/brqdigitalsolutions


Curtiu? Então inscreva-se e venha para o melhor da Transformação Digital com a gente!

title: Desenvolvedor D365 F&O (Azure Logic Apps)
description:
Você é apaixonado por construir soluções em nuvem que impulsionam a transformação empresarial? Responsabilidades:


• Criar e implantar Azure Logic Apps para automatizar fluxos de trabalho e integrar sistemas.

• Liderar processos ETL para limpeza, mapeamento e migração de dados para o D365 F&O.

• Desenvolver soluções personalizadas em X++ utilizando pipelines do Azure DevOps.

• Criar APIs, conectores e scripts para integração fluida entre aplicativos.

• Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções de alto impacto.

• Orientar membros da equipe sobre boas práticas com Azure Logic Apps.

• Garantir segurança, conformidade e manter documentação detalhada.



Experiência:


• Mínimo de 5 anos de experiência em automação de fluxos de trabalho em nuvem e integrações de sistemas.

• Forte domínio de Azure Logic Apps, Azure Functions e serviços relacionados.

• Compreensão sólida da estrutura de banco de dados do D365 F&O e desenvolvimento em X++.

• Experiência com SQL, SSIS, APIs RESTful e serviços SOAP.

• Habilidade com Azure DevOps, testes/debugging e otimização de desempenho.

• Excelentes habilidades de resolução de problemas, gestão de tempo e comunicação.

• Graduação em Ciência da Computação ou experiência equivalente.
